description_en: A rectangular cane handbag with three fabric-lined compartments joined by pleated leather gussets and rigid handles. Canonical front: a flat rectangular woven plate and small central clasp. Side view: three separate folded gussets and handle pivots. Rear view: a second flat woven plate with a leather pocket opening. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.

Create ONE photorealistic alternate catalog view of THAT SAME OBJECT, rotating viewpoint only. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. The front-facing features must be hidden on the opposite side. Do not mirror the front image. Reveal the described previously hidden surfaces without redesigning the object. Match background, soft lighting, scale and center placement. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border.
